messages:
Ana Gomez: Quick design question — noticed in the console action bar the primary + icon button spacing feels cramped on narrow breakpoints. Also toasts are overlapping with the floating action on /apps pages. Screenshot in thread. :thinking_face:
Mike Chen: ah yep saw that on staging. Looks like compact spacing tokens are in play: spacing.compact = 8px vs spacing.default = 12px. On 320px the icon eats the label.
Priya Patel: proposal: increase compact button horizontal padding from 8px -> 12px, keep vertical 6px so hit target stays >= 44px. Also add an explicit token for icon gap: component.button.icon-gap = 8px.
Tom Hayes: dev note — changing base spacing tokens can be risky. Suggest we introduce button.compact.icon-gap so other components don't regressed. We should ship a migration note.
Karla Ruiz: a11y nit: make sure icon-only buttons always have aria-labels and visible focus. Also check CSS min-width/min-height to guarantee 44px touch target.
Ana Gomez: agreed. On toasts — there's a z-index order bug: long toast action gets rendered above modal header on /integrations. CSS right now: .toast { z-index: 1050 } and modal header is 1040. Sounds like inconsistent layer tokens.
Mike Chen: we should centralize layers via tokens: layer.toast, layer.modal, layer.popover. But changing the numeric values might reorder other things. Alternative: introduce semantic layer names and a runtime map that can be tuned per app.
Priya Patel: copy tweak: product prefers toast action label to be 'Undo' (short) instead of 'Revert to previous'. Also tooltip for compact icon buttons currently shows token names — we should show friendlier copy.
Tom Hayes: here's a quick experiment CSS to try on the branch:

```
.button--compact { padding: 6px 12px; gap: 8px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--layer-toast, 1050); position: fixed; right: 16px; }
```

I'll push an experimental branch to prototype.
Karla Ruiz: a11y: toasts should use aria-live="polite" for non-critical info and role="alert" for error to ensure screen readers announce. Also add keyboard focus handling if toast has action.
Ana Gomez: :thumbsup: can we add a small a11y checklist to the PR template for component changes (hit targets, aria attributes, focus states)? Also prefer token names in docs rather than raw pixel values.
Mike Chen: will do. Branch: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/compare/compact-icons (pushing now).
Tom Hayes: pushed experiment branch. @Ana Gomez please review visual diffs. If approved we add new tokens with migration notes + changelog.
Priya Patel: also preference for mobile: stack toasts vertically rather than overlaying primary CTA. On small screens vertical stack with small gap works better.
Karla Ruiz: noted — mobile stacking rule: max-height: calc(100vh - 160px) and allow internal scroll if overflow. Also ensure focus is trapped correctly when toasts contain an action.
Ana Gomez: thanks all — scheduling a 15-min sync in 15 to land token names and copy. /remind me in 15
